content:
Zoya Malik: Hi folks  first day at Redwood! Im Zoya (infra tooling), based in BOS. Quick questions: 1) My MDM says 'enrolled' but SSH keys not provisioned yet. 2) Where is the canonical list of onboard tasks for infra folks? 3) Any spare USB-A->USB-C adapters in the office? Fun fact: I collect tiny succulents and will bring one for the office shelf :seedling:
Onboarding-Bot: Welcome Zoya! :tada: SSH keys are generated after the IAM sync (usually ~15-30m post-enrollment). If not present run `it-ssh setup` and paste the output. Onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard/infrastructure. For adapters, check the hardware bank or file a facilities request.
Hema Singh: welcome Zoya!! :wave: Im your onboarding buddy. Ill check the IAM sync logs and DM you. The infra checklist has an extra section for tooling `devbox-setup.md`. Also we usually keep a few adapters in the "common drawer" by the SF printer.
Leo Santos: hi Zoya  welcome to infra. If `it-ssh setup` errors with "no-key", reply here with the output and Ill escalate to IT. Also we have a 1pm pairing session to walk through our internal CLI; drop in if youre free.
Facilities: Hi Zoya  Facilities here. We have USB-A->USB-C adapters available; request created if you want one reserved. Please confirm delivery location (office desk or shipping to home).
Zoya Malik: ran `it-ssh setup` and got: `Error: no-key-present`  attaching output. Hema, thanks  DM sent. Prefer desk delivery. Also bringing a small jade plant  will label it :smile:
Devex-Bot: Hardware ticket FAC-5120 created for adapter (desk pickup). IT ticket IT-9188 opened for SSH key provisioning. Youll get updates here. Also, welcome swag pack scheduled for delivery tomorrow.
Hema Singh: IT found the issue  there was a gap in the IAM sync window. Ticket IT-9188 updated and keys should appear within 20m. Ill stay on this thread until it resolves.
Leo Santos: nice  jade plant welcome ritual acknowledged :joy: If you want, well add a tiny label with your name on the plant shelf. Also ping me after keys provisioned and well pair on the CLI at 1pm.
Zoya Malik: keys showed up  `ssh zoya@jump.redwood.internal` works now. Thanks Hema and team! Ill bring the jade plant to the shelf after lunch and join the 1pm pairing. So excited to be here :grinning_face_with_big_eyes:
